literal_meaning: ধরে ধরে আবেদন করা (holding and persistently holding)
figurative_meaning_en: Earnest and persistent entreaty for favor or mercy
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি ধরাধরি করে চাকরির জন্য অনুরোধ করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He made an earnest entreaty for the job through persistent pleading.
Through persistent entreaty, we received the help.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Bengali modes of humble supplication in social interactions.
